FOUNDING_PERSONALITY: mean, sd, lo, hi of each drawn personality and emotion parameter. lo or hi null means unclipped. The values are authored and have no source (APPROX).

FOUNDING_CAUSAL_RESOLUTION: the trait-level causal-belief resolution (a bin count), a two-component mixture. The floor component is the floor-heavy, naive subgroup and the ceiling component is the ceiling-heavy, exposed subgroup. Sources, as recorded in the code this was moved from: Frederick 2005 (CRT, combined N=3428) and Stieger & Reips 2016 (N=2137). The research basis is docs/research/Bigville graph runtime/CAUSAL_GRANULARITY_POPULATION_DISTRIBUTION_RESEARCH.md sec 7 point 4 and sec 8. floor mean 3.0 sd 1.0 anchors the CRT floor and CAN's coarse condition (3 J values). ceiling mean 7.5 sd 2.0 anchors Miller (1956) and Preston & Colman (2000), whose convergent optimum is 7, reaching toward the past-ceiling band 9-12. ceiling_weight 0.35 lies inside Frederick's 17% combined perfect-score rate and Stieger & Reips' ~33% educated-subgroup rate. lo 2 and hi 12 are the registered range of research sec 8 point 1. See BIGVILLE_CAN_INTEGRATION_PREREG.md sec 3. NOTE: the research and prereg files named in this note are not in this checkout (checked at Phase 016a), so these citations are carried over unverified.
